topics.title: Human–Judge Agreement and Decision Stability in Bilingual Question Answering: A Controlled Evaluation Proposal
topics.gap: These precedents support a narrowly scoped study, not the assertion that multilingual human-reference evaluation is missing. We propose to examine the selected QA setting through an integrated protocol that makes human agreement, language-related decision changes and repeated-call behavior independently observable. The novelty of the combined protocol remains unconfirmed.

topics.title: Fact or Form? A Controlled Invariance Audit of Hallucination Detectors
topics.gap: Existing work documents label problems, response-length effects, domain shift and detector-family blind spots. The narrower unresolved question is whether factual discrimination survives controlled changes in answer form within the same human-validated items.

topics.title: Do Faithfulness Gains Survive the Metric? A Specificity-Controlled Audit of Iterative Explanation Refinement
topics.gap: Existing work covers iterative explanation refinement, intervention-guided optimization and faithfulness-metric audits. The narrower unresolved question is whether gains optimized under one measure transfer to an independent measure and exceed specificity controls.

topics.title: Origin, Editor, or Mixture? A Bidirectional Revision-History Audit of AI-Text Detectors
topics.gap: Existing work covers hybrid sentences, paraphrase attacks, realistic rewrites and human editing of model drafts. The narrower unresolved question is how detector outputs relate to distinct process labels in matched bidirectional revision trajectories.

topics.title: Safe and Useful Across Singapore Language Settings: A Matched Evaluation of Unsafe Compliance and False Refusal
topics.gap: Singapore-focused toxicity data, multilingual guardrails and native-reviewed refusal benchmarks already exist. The narrower unresolved question combines matched harmful and benign boundaries, independent equivalence review and joint guardrail-response analysis in selected Singapore settings.
